pre_registered_decision_rule.genuine_positive: HUMAN_REVIEWED_TRUE AND commercially_actionable is true, unanimous among human1/human2 rows present on that message
pre_registered_decision_rule.prevalence_denominator: hist_random messages with at least one human1/human2 review
pre_registered_decision_rule.kappa: Cohen kappa on paired human1/human2 labels

codes.HISTORY_SOURCE_ABSENT: both denominators meet the minimums AND genuine positives are 0 on hist_random AND on hist_recall_probe
codes.HISTORY_HAS_DEMAND: denominators meet the minimums AND hist_random Clopper-Pearson lower bound >= 0.005
codes.HISTORY_DEMAND_SCARCE: denominators meet the minimums AND the row is neither SOURCE_ABSENT nor HAS_DEMAND

pre_registered_decision_rule.zero_reviews: BLOCKED_PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW. Do not emit HISTORY_SOURCE_ABSENT or HISTORY_HAS_DEMAND from an empty review set.

reason: Reviews are not yet complete. HISTORY_SOURCE_ABSENT requires n_random>=1200 and n_probe>=600 actually reviewed. Zero reviews are not source absence.
